messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف معلومات غير موجودة، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON فقط وفق الشكل: {"book_code":"TADAM","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"..."}]}. أخرج وحدة واحدة لكل مدخل بالترتيب. إذا كان مرجع المصدر مجمّعاً مثل 1,2 فترجم نصه مرة واحدة واجعل verse أول رقم فقط، ولا تقسّمه إلى وحدتين.

{"book_code":"TADAM","units":[{"chapter":28,"source_ref":"28:3","text":"After I had worshipped the Lord, straightway Michael, God's archangel, seized my hand and"},{"chapter":28,"source_ref":"28:4","text":"cast me out of the paradise of 'vision' and of God's command. And Michael held a rod in his hand, and he touched the waters, which were round about paradise, and they froze hard."},{"chapter":29,"source_ref":"29:1","text":"And I went across, and Michael the archangel went across with me, and he led me back to"},{"chapter":29,"source_ref":"29:2","text":"the place whence he had caught me up. Hearken, my son Seth, even to the rest of the secrets [and sacraments] that shall be, which were revealed to me, when I had eaten of the tree of the"},{"chapter":29,"source_ref":"29:3","text":"knowledge, and knew and perceived what will come to pass in this age; [what God intends to do"}]}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return one item per input unit, in input order, using the first printed number when a source label is grouped: 28:3, 28:4, 29:1, 29:2, 29:3.
